newsitem.title: JAPAN: DKB vice president Fujita to take presidency - paper.
newsitem.headline: DKB vice president Fujita to take presidency - paper.

text.p: Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd (DKB) plans to appoint vice president Ichiro Fujita to the post of president, replacing Katsuhiko Kondo who will step down to take responsibility for DKB's role in a scandal, the Mainichi Shimbun's wire service reported on Thursday.
It added that another vice president, Yoshiharu Mani, is expected to replace the current chairman, Tadashi Okuda, who will also resign.
The bank's board of directors is expected to approve the new top management at a meeting on Friday, the report said.
A DKB spokeswoman said that the bank has not yet decided on any changes in its top management and that it has no plans to hold a news conference today.

The Asahi Shimbun said on Thursday that DKB had decided to seek the resignation of its chairman and president because of the bank's involvement in a racketeer payoff scandal at Nomura Securities Co Ltd.
